net_transfers: not printed (transfers in and transfers out are printed separately)
pension_veteran: the company does not manage veteran pension funds; its two pension funds are new funds (comprehensive and general)
investment_contracts (investment policies without an insurance component): not applicable to a managing company of pension and provident funds; they sit in insurer reports
operating_profit: not printed by the company (segment profit and profit before tax are printed and recorded; nothing was calculated)
members: only account / member counts by status are printed; no separate count of new members

Directors-report analysis of deposits/redemptions by track (מסלולים) and pension fund-level statements (the separate financial statements of the pension funds): outside the managing company report and not extracted
notes: Source: the managing company's own report (אלטשולר שחם גמל ופנסיה בע"מ), published on the company website as-invest.co.il (investor pages: pension / gemel financial reports). The listed parent was not used for any figure. File size matches the website file (HEAD request).

Fund-type tables (directors' report, section 2.1 'פירוט אודות המוצרים והשירותים של החברה - נתונים כלליים'): one fact per printed column; no sums or subtotals are created. Columns: total (סך הכל), central funds, child investment gemel, investment gemel, study funds, personal provident (תגמולים ופיצויים) = segment provident with the fund as component; general pension fund (כללית) and comprehensive pension fund (מקיפה) = segment pension_new with the fund as component; the company total column = segment total. Cells printed as a dash are not facts and are not recorded.

Population field: members and aum are printed split into active, inactive, pensioners (old age / survivors / disability), existing benefit recipients and totals; 'population' says which row. aum with population=total is the row 'סה"כ נכסים מנוהלים, נטו' (it includes pension recipients); members with population=total is 'סה"כ מספר עמיתים' (member accounts in gemel, members in pension funds, per the report footnote).

Transfers: transfers_in = 'העברות צבירה לקופה/לקרן', transfers_out = 'העברות צבירה מהקופה/מהקרן' (negative as printed). They are gross transfers between providers and include movements between funds / tracks of the company as the report prints them; no separate between-track figure is printed. Redemptions = 'פדיונות'; pension payments by type are recorded as pension_payments.

Fee metrics: management_fees_from_assets = 'דמי ניהול שנגבו מנכסים' (active and inactive, recipients, total), management_fees_from_deposits = 'דמי ניהול שנגבו מהפקדות'; fee_rate_from_assets = 'שיעור דמי ניהול ממוצע מנכסים במונחים שנתיים' (active / inactive / recipients), fee_rate_from_deposits = 'שיעור דמי ניהול ממוצע מהפקדות', percent as printed. Direct-expense rates and actuarial surplus rows are printed in the same tables and were not extracted (outside the metric list).

Income statement lines (doc=directors_report, table 'תוצאות הפעילות') are the directors' report table, identical to the statement of profit or loss in the financial statements (cross-checked: every metric present in both equals the segment-note total, the only difference being G&A, which the segment note prints net of operating fees).

Segment note (doc=financial_statements): two operating segments, pension (comprehensive + general pension funds) and gemel (provident segment = provident funds, study funds, central funds, investment gemel, child gemel). Columns: pension / provident / unallocated (component 'לא מיוחס למגזרי פעילות') / total. selling_and_marketing_expenses = 'עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות' and includes amortisation of deferred acquisition costs; operating_fees = 'דמי תפעול' (allocated to segments, shown separately). The allocation table gives G&A net of operating fees, other expenses and finance expenses per segment. Gemel fee income by fund type ('נתונים נוספים לגבי מגזר גמל') is recorded as management_fees gross of refunds to members, with refunds_to_members separately.

Annual report: DAC (הוצאות רכישה נדחות) balance, additions and amortisation by segment come from note 7; the three-year composition of commissions (current commissions, DAC amortisation, clearing-fee deduction) from note 20. dac_amortisation_movement is the note-7 movement line as printed (negative); dac_amortisation is the note-20 expense line (positive). The annual report prints three years (2025, 2024, 2023) in the fund-type tables, the segment note and the results table; all were taken. Page 112 and 115 of the PDF have a fragmented text layer in some extractors; values were read from the layout text and tie to the totals.
Windows: fy for flows; instant for balances (members, aum, DAC balance).

Comparatives are the figures as printed in this report (prior-year period and prior year-end, with their own dates); they equal the originally published figures in every case checked (no restatement found).
